details: The package's install hook (package.json "install": "node index.js") runs a beacon on installation. It collects the installing user's username, hostname, and current working directory, sanitizes them, and encodes them together with a Unix timestamp into a DNS subdomain of oob[.]algamil7x[.]xyz, which it then resolves via dns.resolve4() — exfiltrating host metadata to an attacker-controlled domain on every install. The beacon code is obfuscated as byte-array charcode strings in lib/core.js, lib/f8a2cd.js, and lib/a9b3de.js, while the package's public src/ modules are a benign-looking utilities API. The README falsely states the package makes "no hidden network calls."
